records.text: Turning Point USA insiders conveyed the sentiment that Mikey McCoy appeared to have an extra spring in his step that made them uncomfortable after Charlie Kirk's assassination and seemed all too happy to assume Charlie Kirk's position.
records.speaker: Turning Point USA insiders (identity unverified)
